stations.title: Triage
stations.text: Picks one queue for each email.

captions: At Pebblebrook Plants, Ines wants to know how good triage really is.
Today the team pastes a few tickets and reads the answers. That is a feeling.
You write the eval: a test set, a fair scorer and a report, in three tasks.
Now every ticket in the set runs, and triage gets a pass rate.
Same question, a real number, and a list of every miss.
